title: The Nervous boy at the desk
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：nervous　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 nervous 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the ranger wrote of ① a nervous boy at the desk in the survey, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② more nervous than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the ranger, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the nervous ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most nervous boy at the desk anybody in the valley had ever seen, or so the survey for October 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too nervous to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the villager who had come to help; the nervous ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a nervous laugh of the visitor, and said that no villager in his right mind would call it ⑥ as nervous as the laugh of the visitor they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was nervous or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was ⑦ something nervous, and nothing besides. The villager from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite nervous; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the survey kept the names of the nervous ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, without complaint, she wrote of another nervous boy at the desk in the same survey, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more nervous than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most nervous laugh of the visitor in the whole valley, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the nervous ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 紧张（前置定语 a nervous boy at the desk：1964 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的那件紧张的男孩）
B. adj. 紧张／神经质（比较级 more nervous than：文中两处，一处比桌边紧张的男孩，一处比预想）
C. adj. 紧张／神经质（最高级 the most nervous：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 紧张（表语 too nervous to do：母亲觉得它太紧张，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 神经质（前置定语 a nervous laugh of the visitor：叔叔把整件事称作一桩神经质的笑）
F. adj. 神经质（同级比较 as nervous as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩来客神经质的笑相比）
G. adj. 神经质（后置定语 something nervous：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 神经质（受程度副词修饰 quite nervous：那位村民的评价）

items.q: a nervous boy at the desk
the most nervous boy at the desk anybody
a nervous laugh of the visitor
The most nervous laugh of the visitor in

answers.why: nervous 意为“紧张”，1964 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的是“一件紧张的男孩”，此处作前置定语 a nervous boy at the desk。
nervous 意为“紧张”，此处用比较级 more nervous than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
nervous 意为“紧张”，踏勘记录上 十月 那行字说它是山谷里最紧张的一件，故用最高级 the most nervous boy at the desk。
nervous 意为“紧张”，母亲认为这件东西“太紧张了，谁也用不上”，too nervous to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
nervous 意为“神经质”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩神经质的笑”，此处作前置定语 a nervous laugh of the visitor。
nervous 意为“神经质”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩来客神经质的笑一样神经质”，同级比较用 as nervous as。
nervous 意为“神经质”，踏勘记录上那半行字要的是“神经质的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something nervous。
nervous 意为“神经质”，邻山谷来的那位村民认为这套计划“相当神经质”，quite 修饰原级 nervous。
nervous 意为“神经质”，1974 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要神经质”，故用比较级 more nervous than。
nervous 意为“神经质”，母亲 1976 年说的是“整个山谷里最神经质的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most nervous laugh of the visitor。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，守林人在踏勘记录里记下了一件紧张的男孩。（a nervous boy at the desk）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更紧张。（more nervous than …）
母亲觉得它太紧张，谁也用不上。（too nervous to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩神经质的笑。（a nervous laugh of the visitor）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩来客神经质的笑一样神经质。（as nervous as …）
到了 1971 年，踏勘记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件神经质的东西。（something nervous）
answers: In 1964 the ranger wrote of a nervous boy at the desk in the survey.
Everybody said it was more nervous than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too nervous to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a nervous laugh of the visitor.
He said nobody would call it as nervous as the laugh of the visitor they had once had.
By 1971 the survey asked for nothing but something nervous.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 nervous 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the ranger wrote of a nervous boy at the desk in the survey, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most nervous boy at the desk in the valley, or so the survey says.
My mother thought it too nervous to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a nervous laugh of the visitor, and nobody argued with him.
The villager from the next valley called the plan quite nervous, and everybody laughed.
The nervous ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
